name: OONI API (Open Observatory of Network Interference measurements and aggregation)
tier_rationale: Established non-profit internet-measurement project with open methodology and published data policy (A8 trusted); P023 chair rationale: 'OONI is an established non-profit measurement project: tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Volunteer probe measurements with automated analysis: 'confirmed' is a fingerprinted block page, single anomalies are often network noise (live 30-day data shows sporadic anomalies where nothing is blocked).

error_markers.reason: OONI API: error message inside an HTTP 200 answer (could not verify)

api.title: OONI API v1 /measurements?domain=&probe_cc=&limit= (metadata.next_url pagination) and /aggregation?domain=&probe_cc=&since=&until=

api.notes: Research C0049 (verified_live 200). P023 cond 3: the council header said 'open' pending the exact Creative Commons variant; the OONI data licence is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (github.com/ooni/license data/LICENSE.md at commit ce329e1d, linked as 'Data License' from ooni.org/data/; data/Readme.md: 'This license applies to all published OONI data ... on https://api.ooni.io and https://explorer.ooni.io'). Per cond 3 the source is therefore classed noncommercial and is off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared (licence_allow entry, e.g. a provider_grant: OONI's licence README invites requests for other terms at contact@openobservatory.org). Attribution: report footer + notice ooni_data. Keyless; an invalid probe_cc answers 200 with an empty list (validated before sending); x-ratelimit-remaining ~4000 units per egress IP observed (undocumented). Used by ooni.

explorer_pages.title: OONI Explorer pages (explorer.ooni.org/m/<measurement_uid>, /domain/<host>): manual links only, never fetched

explorer_pages.notes: explorer.ooni.org answered 429 then 403 with a Vercel Security Checkpoint (x-vercel-mitigated: challenge) to scripted requests from a datacenter egress (2026-11-26): manual links for the analyst's browser only, never requested (A9).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G01-2 (P023 ooni). Context only: OONI anomalies and confirmed blocks are shown as info and never contribute to the risk score (P023 cond 2). No published rate limit: the quota block is a conservative per-egress budget (250/day at 80%, about one request per 1.25 s).
